name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select i.id, i.ref || ' ' || c.name as label from invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.client_id order by i.ref

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.ref as invoice, c.name as client, c.contact_name as attention, to_char(i.month, 'Month YYYY') as month, i.issued_on, i.due_on, i.currency from invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.client_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Lines
sections.sql: select l.description, l.kind, i.currency, l.amount_cents from invoice_lines l join invoices i on i.id = l.invoice_id where l.invoice_id = $1 order by l.kind, l.description

sections.title: Total
sections.sql: select currency, subtotal_cents, gst_cents, total_cents from invoices where id = $1

name: inspection-report
title: Quality inspection report
for_each: select i.id, i.ref || ' ' || s.name as label from inspections i join sites s on s.id = i.site_id order by i.ref

sections.title: Inspection
sections.sql: select ref, site_name as site, inspected_on, inspector, with_client, items_checked, faults, score_pct from v_inspections where id = $1

sections.title: Faults found
sections.sql: select area, item, fix_by, fixed_on, fixed_by from faults where inspection_id = $1 order by area, item

name: scope-of-works
title: Scope of works
for_each: select id, name from sites order by code

sections.title: Site
sections.sql: select s.name as site, c.name as client, s.address, s.days_a_week as days_a_week, s.contract_start, s.contract_end from sites s join clients c on c.id = s.client_id where s.id = $1

sections.title: Tasks
sections.sql: select area, task, frequency from scope_tasks where site_id = $1 and active order by frequency_days(frequency), area, task

name: incident-report
title: Incident report
for_each: select i.id, i.ref || ' ' || s.code as label from incidents i join sites s on s.id = i.site_id order by i.ref

sections.title: Incident
sections.sql: select ref, site, client, occurred_at, kind, summary, cleaner, injury, notifiable, regulator_notified_at, regulator_reference, client_notified_at, standing from v_incidents where id = $1

name: key-register
title: Key and access register
for_each: select id, name from sites where exists (select 1 from keys k where k.site_id = sites.id) order by code

sections.title: Keys, cards and codes
sections.sql: select label, kind, held_by, issued_on, standing from v_keys where site_id = $1 order by label
